detection_summary.signing_effect: Certificate can reduce reputation friction, but EDR review is still required.

likely_classification.Bitdefender: ATC review: persistence via scheduled task

command_findings.why: Scheduled task creation is legitimate for management software, but is also a common malware persistence technique.
command_findings.recommendation: Prefer a named signed Windows service or transparent HKCU Run entry, with installer UI and uninstall metadata.

likely_classification.Bitdefender: EDR review: remote management command channel

command_findings.why: Polling and executing server commands is normal for an RMM/EDR agent, but must be tightly scoped and audited.
command_findings.recommendation: Keep an explicit allowlist, signed command payloads, audit logging, and clear product identity.
